title: The ossaudiodev module was removed in Python 3.13
summary: Python 3.13 removed the ossaudiodev module (PEP 594), so importing it raises ModuleNotFoundError.

sources.title: PEP 594 — Removing dead batteries from the standard library

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; replace the removed module with a maintained library or remove the dependency.

steps.title: Replace the ossaudiodev import
steps.instructions: Remove each reported import of ossaudiodev; it has no standard-library replacement.

verification.purpose: Run the tests with deprecation warnings treated as errors when pytest is used.
